MEET THE ARTIST / 실리카겔

Silica Gel

Silica Gel is a four-piece band with two vocalists: guitarist Kim Chunchu and keyboardist Kim Hanjoo, joined by drummer Kim Geonjay and bassist Choi Woonghee.

BY INDIEK / PUBLISHED 2026-11-12

Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓
SONG PAGESNO PAIN ↗Tik Tak Tok (feat. So!YoON!) ↗

Their self-titled first album earned them Rookie of the Year at the Korean Music Awards.

INDIE ROCK / 2022

NO PAIN

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

“NO PAIN” invites people who have felt excluded into a house where everyone can sing together. The speaker also considers leaving and asks not to be hated, keeping that welcome unsettled.

Lyrics by Silica Gel; music by Silica Gel; arranged by Silica Gel; produced by Silica Gel.

INDIE ROCK / 2023

Tik Tak Tok (feat. So!YoON!)

Official music video

View release on Apple Music ↗

Silica Gel and So!YoON! share the lyric and music credits on “Tik Tak Tok”. Its release statement asks whether Machine Boy is a living creature or another kind of existence that cannot be described.

A little background

Released on August 19, 2023, Tik Tak Tok - Single places “T” before the featured song. The selected music video includes both tracks, so its running time is longer than the individual Apple Music recording.

Lyrics by Silica Gel and So!YoON!; music by Silica Gel and So!YoON!; arranged by Silica Gel; produced by Silica Gel.

Official music video · 07:30
